metadata.description: hvantk workflow skills for coding agents

plugins.name: hvantk
plugins.description: Workflow skills for driving hvantk analyses with a coding agent: run Hail-backed hvantk commands on a Slurm cluster from the container image, joint genotyping and callset delivery, dataset builds and drift triage, the gene index, cohort burden, re-ranking and QTL-cascade analyses, and labelled ML training sets.
